article_title: Jeffrey Archer: Best-selling author and former politician dies aged 86

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: The death and varied career of author and former politician Jeffrey Archer
A new law about British publishers and political memoirs
The reopening of Wellington School after a long closure
A dispute over who owns the rights to Kane and Abel
tasks.correct_answer: The death and varied career of author and former politician Jeffrey Archer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסכמת את מותו של ג'פרי ארצ'ר ואת הקריירות הבולטות שלו כסופר וכפוליטיקאי, כולל תקופת המאסר.

tasks.prompt: According to HarperCollins, what was Archer doing on the day before he died?
options: Attending a Conservative Party conference
Teaching a writing class at Wellington School
Signing books with broadcaster Gyles Brandreth at a London theatre
Visiting the House of Lords for a debate
tasks.correct_answer: Signing books with broadcaster Gyles Brandreth at a London theatre
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המו״ל מסר שביום ראשון ארצ'ר חתם על ספרים עם גיילס ברנדרת' בתיאטרון Leicester Square בלונדון.

tasks.prompt: What does “perjury” mean in the context of Archer's 2001 conviction?
options: Publishing a book without permission
Lying while under oath in a legal case
Leaving public office before an election
Receiving money from a newspaper
tasks.correct_answer: Lying while under oath in a legal case
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר המשפטי, perjury פירושה עדות שקר או שקר תחת שבועה; ארצ'ר הורשע בכך לאחר משפט הדיבה.

tasks.prompt: How many books did the article say Archer sold during his five-decade writing career?
options: About 30 million
Exactly 86 million
Nearly 150 million
More than 300 million
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שארצ'ר מכר יותר מ־300 מיליון ספרים לאורך קריירת כתיבה שנמשכה חמישה עשורים.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article mention that Archer was writing and signing books shortly before his death?
options: To show that he remained actively involved in writing and meeting readers
To suggest that his publisher had stopped supporting him
To prove that his political career was about to restart
To explain why his final novel had been cancelled
tasks.correct_answer: To show that he remained actively involved in writing and meeting readers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפרטים על כתיבה בין מפגשים וחתימה למעריצים מדגישים שהוא המשיך ליצור ולעסוק בקוראים ממש עד מותו.

tasks.prompt: In Brandreth's tribute, what does “self-deprecating” most nearly mean?
options: Proud of every past achievement
Unwilling to speak in public
Able to joke modestly about himself
Critical of everyone around him
tasks.correct_answer: Able to joke modestly about himself
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה מתארת אדם שמקטין את עצמו בהומור או צוחק על עצמו בצניעות; כך ברנדרת' תיאר את ארצ'ר.

tasks.prompt: Give two facts about Archer's political career before and after prison.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי עובדות מדויקות, אחת יכולה להיות על כהונתו כחבר פרלמנט או סגן יו״ר המפלגה, ואחת על המאסר, השחרור, החזרה לבית הלורדים או הפרישה.
expected_points: Accept any two accurate facts: elected MP for Louth in 1969
returned to the House of Lords

tasks.prompt: Summarise Archer's life as presented in the article, including his writing, politics and legal troubles.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להזכיר את הצלחתו העצומה כסופר, את הקריירה במפלגה השמרנית, ואת ההרשעה והמאסר שהכתימו אותה.
expected_points: He sold more than 300 million books over a five-decade career.
He served as an MP and later as Conservative Party deputy chairman.
He was jailed in 2001 for perjury and perverting the course of justice after his libel case.
He later returned to the House of Lords and continued publishing until shortly before his death.

tasks.prompt: How do the tributes from Brandreth, HarperCollins and Nadhim Zahawi build a picture of Archer's personality?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד הפרטים בעדויות משלימים זה את זה: מספר סיפורים כריזמטי ומצחיק, חרוץ מאוד, חם ובעל אנרגיה רבה.
expected_points: Brandreth portrays him as funny, engaging and a great storyteller.
His editor stresses his hard work, repeated drafting and teamwork.
Zahawi highlights his wit, warmth and boundless energy.
The response should combine the quotations into an overall character portrait.

tasks.prompt: Write a short newspaper-style concluding paragraph for this obituary using only facts from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הפסקה צריכה להיות תמציתית, עובדתית ובסגנון חדשותי, ולשלב לפחות שניים: ספרו האחרון, משפחתו, מורשתו הספרותית או מחוות ההספד.
expected_points: Mention at least two relevant closing details, such as the final novel Adam and Eve, his wife Mary and family, book sales, or tributes.
